messages:
SecurityBot: :rotating_light: SECURITY ADVISORY: Privileged SSH key 'ml-deploy-prod' discovered in a public repo scanner. Treat as compromised — immediate rotation and revocation required.

Sam (sec): Quick context: routine repo scan flagged an SSH deploy key with access to the dedicated GPU pool. No evidence of exfiltration yet, but we must assume compromise and proceed with containment.

Jordan (eng-platform): Can you confirm which hosts and which CI jobs use that key?

Sam (sec): Affected: dedicated-gpu-01, dedicated-gpu-02, dedicated-gpu-03. Key label: ml-deploy-prod. Owner: eng-ml team principal (Priya). CI: gha/workflows/deploy-ml.yml and a legacy Jenkins job.

Priya (eng-ml): Confirmed — that was an ad-hoc deploy key I added last year for model warmup. I'm on it.

Sam (sec): Immediate action checklist (required, complete by 2024-05-09T18:00Z):
1) Rotate the secret in Secrets Manager: `rwctl secrets rotate ml-deploy-prod`
2) Revoke the old public key from all affected hosts: `ssh-key-revoke --target dedicated-gpu-* --key ml-deploy-prod`
3) Update CI/CD: replace the secret in GH Actions + Jenkins, run a full test deploy
4) Post the new key fingerprint in-DM to Sam (sec) and confirm in-thread with `DONE <fingerprint>`
5) If you cannot complete before the deadline, escalate to oncall@redwood immediately.

Mateo (ops): Starting revocation on the three hosts now — I'll take dedicated-gpu-01.

Priya (eng-ml): Rotating secrets now. New key generated, pushing to secrets manager. New fingerprint (will DM): SHA256:Zk7N9uYpLr8X1a2b3C4dE5f6G7h8Ij9K0lMnoPqRstU=

Jordan (eng-platform): I added a short-term enforcement: service account keys older than 90 days are blocked for automated deploys. SecurityBot, please run a full audit against all repos and infra secrets after rotation.

SecurityBot: Audit queued (scan id: scan-20240508-009). Will post findings in this thread when complete.

Sam (sec): Reminder: rotate any downstream copies (on-call jump boxes, backup configs). Use `secret-check --find ml-deploy-prod` to locate duplicates.

Priya (eng-ml): DONE SHA256:Zk7N9uYp... — hosts revoked, CI updated, test deploy succeeded.

Mateo (ops): DONE — revoked key on gpu-01/02/03, verified no new SSH sessions after revocation.

Jordan (eng-platform): DONE — pipeline green, Jenkins creds rotated. Added a follow-up ticket to onboard short-lived service keys for ml infra.

SecurityBot: Audit result: no remaining exposures found for ml-deploy-prod. Remaining findings: 1 low-risk token in an archived repo (no access). Overall status: mitigated. :white_check_mark:

Sam (sec): Thanks all. Closing follow-up in 24h if no regression. If anyone sees suspicious activity, @Sam (sec) and oncall@redwood. :lock:

Priya (eng-ml): Thanks — will run additional post-rotation smoke tests overnight and report back if anything odd.
